title: asclepias longifolia subsp. hirtella
intro: Asclepias longifolia subsp. hirtella, commonly known as Hairy Milkweed, is a plant species within the Asclepias genus, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This perennial herb is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Asclepias longifolia subsp. hirtella include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of Hairy Milkweed include cardenolides, glycosides, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects and have been studied for their potential in developing new treatments for various diseases.
